sync.title: Supercomputing and Europe’s AI Future
sync.rawTitle: #11 - Cristian Canton: Supercomputing and Europe’s AI Future | Leading in AI Podcast
sync.youtubeDescription:
Cristian Canton is Associate Director of the Barcelona Supercomputing Center (BSC), home of MareNostrum 5, one of the most powerful supercomputers in Europe. Before returning to Barcelona after 15 years in the US, he led Responsible AI at Meta, working on the safety and robustness of the Llama models, after years as a researcher at Microsoft.

In this episode, Cristian explains what it took to build safe large language models with no playbook, how BSC is opening supercomputing to startups through the AI Factory, and why he believes AI and quantum computing could unlock a new era of scientific progress.

Topics covered:
- Building Llama safely at Meta: trade-offs, guardrails and serving every language
- Why he came back to Barcelona to lead BSC
- Inside MareNostrum 5 and the quantum computers housed in a former chapel
- The AI Factory: free supercomputing and expert support for startups and SMEs
- Europe’s AI gigafactories and the push for technological sovereignty
- How BSC turns research into spin-offs like Qilimanjaro and OpenChip
- Partnering with industry: the Repsol story and beyond
- Where AI and quantum computing meet
